say:2:1041202001:1.source_cn: 要是问我和达米安的相遇……

say:3:1041202002:1.text: It feels like it was just yesterday!

say:4:1041202003:0.text: One time, I left the forest to gather materials and accidentally ended up in a remote mountain area where Korin lived.
say:4:1041202003:0.source_cn: 那时候，我离开丛林外出取材，对外界还不熟悉，结果跑到了...

say:5:1041202004:1.text: Perhaps noticing I was alone and heading deeper into the mountains, he called out to warn me about bandits and advised me to go home.
say:5:1041202004:1.source_cn: 可能是看我独自一人，走的路又是进山方向，他就喊住了我，...

say:6:1041202005:1.text: As soon as Uncle Korin was out of earshot, I turned around and delved even deeper into the mountains—after all, when it comes to forests, I'm quite familiar with them!
say:6:1041202005:1.source_cn: 等科林大叔走远了，我就立刻掉头往山里走——毕竟，对于树...

say:7:1041202006:1.text: *Sigh* I should've known you're not the type to take advice from others...
say:7:1041202006:1.source_cn: ……唉，我早该看出你不是那种听劝的人。

choice_prompt:8:1041202006.text: *Sigh* I should've known you're not the type to take advice from others...
choice_prompt:8:1041202006.source_cn: ……唉，我早该看出你不是那种听劝的人。

say:9:1041202007:1.text: So I walked right into the bandit camp. It only hit me when I saw the flames, but by then, it was too late to run...
say:9:1041202007:1.source_cn: 结果呢，当然！我一头撞进了山匪的营地，我看到火光的时候...

say:10:1041202008:1.text: Those baddies snatched away all my belongings and had me tied up with hemp rope when Korin finally caught up!
say:10:1041202008:1.source_cn: 那些山匪搜走了我身上所有的小玩意，把我捆成麻绳结的时候...

say:11:1041202009:1.text: You have no idea how cool Korin seemed at that time! He picked the bandits up with his spear and tossed them super, super far!
say:11:1041202009:1.source_cn: 你不知道科林大叔那时候有多威风！那些山匪前一秒还在挑衅...

say:12:1041202010:1.text: His moves, his strength—you wouldn't believe he had wooden prosthetics at that moment!
say:12:1041202010:1.source_cn: 那身法，那力量，你绝对不敢相信他当时用是木雕的义肢！

choice_prompt:13:1041202010.text: His moves, his strength—you wouldn't believe he had wooden prosthetics at that moment!
choice_prompt:13:1041202010.source_cn: 那身法，那力量，你绝对不敢相信他当时用是木雕的义肢！

say:14:1041202011:1.text: Oh... those were crafted by my dwarf friend.
say:14:1041202011:1.source_cn: 呵……那是我托矮人朋友帮忙打造的。

say:15:1041202012:1.text: They were alright, I guess... but the joints were too stiff. Even with paint, they wouldn't be able to hold up for long in the damp forest.
say:15:1041202012:1.source_cn: 工艺是还不错啦……不过关节太僵硬，而且山林潮湿，木质很...

choice_prompt:16:1041202012.text: They were alright, I guess... but the joints were too stiff. Even with paint, they wouldn't be able to hold up for long in the damp forest.
choice_prompt:16:1041202012.source_cn: 工艺是还不错啦……不过关节太僵硬，而且山林潮湿，木质很快就会朽坏，就算涂了漆也用不长久！

say:17:1041202013:1.text: After he showed those bandits who's boss, he glared at me without saying anything for, like, forever... His look wasn't 'heroic savior,' it was more like 'you're in trouble now!'
say:17:1041202013:1.source_cn: 科林大叔解决掉山匪之后，一言不发地瞪了我好久，他的眼神...

say:18:1041202014:1.text: Thankfully, when he eventually spoke, it was to ask me to come home with him, so he could tend to the wounds.
say:18:1041202014:1.source_cn: 还好他最后开口说的是让我和他回家，他来处理伤口。

say:19:1041202015:1.text: I couldn't just leave a child alone in the forest.
say:19:1041202015:1.source_cn: 总不能把一个孩子自己丢在丛林里。

say:20:1041202016:1.text: To me, the forest is where I belong. You were being overly cautious.
say:20:1041202016:1.source_cn: 对我来说，在丛林里才像是回家了，大叔你当时太谨慎啦。

say:21:1041202017:1.text: Anyway, Korin saved my life! As a token of gratitude, I used local materials to reinforce his prosthetics.
say:21:1041202017:1.source_cn: 总之，科林大叔就这样成了我的救命恩人！作为答谢，我用当...

say:22:1041202018:1.text: Korin, regardless of how others see you as all stern and grumpy, I know better. You're a kind-hearted soul!
say:22:1041202018:1.source_cn: 科林大叔，不管别人觉得你有多冷冰冰、凶巴巴，反正我比他...

say:23:1041202019:1.text: So, whatever you need, just come straight to me!
say:23:1041202019:1.source_cn: 所以，不管你有什么需要——任何需要，都可以直接来找我！
